name: @appdyno/site
description: appdyno.dev: the landing page and the docs, built from docs/ with Astro and Starlight.

scripts.build: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && cp dist/sitemap-index.xml dist/sitemap.xml
scripts.check: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro sync && pnpm -w exec tsc -p site/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --test
